Personal Homelab.desc: Detailed architectural writeup of multi-server homelab environment.

Amethyst Administrator.desc: Purple team security and network management tool written in Python that is designed to map out and allow pre-configured easy access to devices over large networks.

gl0bSECURE OBD-II Tool.desc: Custom-built Python tool designed to streamline development for other automotive diagnostic tools. Utilizes the CAN protocol that is widely used in automobiles.

CrossJoin.desc:
Operating as project maintainer.

Discord bot designed to monitor and post information from the Alberta Electric System Operator (AESO) and Alberta 511. Engineered the Alberta 511 API integration, API secret management, and production DevOps pipeline

AOSCS.desc:
Advanced Open-Source Certification System (AOSCS).

Built a Jekyll/JS dynamic generator that transforms detailed content taxonomies into open standards with customizable visual branding assets.

DVDSCRPWN.desc:
Image forensics and anti-steganography research toolkit designed for static screenshot analysis. Features CSPRNG-based image modification tools for payload disruption, overlay mapping, and cryptographic filelisting for zero-knowledge asset comparison.

Available to authorized users upon request.

EmbedTube.desc: Firefox extension prototype developed to circumvent playback blocks by dynamically replacing YouTube's main player with lightweight embedded iframe instances.

NoQuoraLogin.desc: Lightweight JavaScript UserScript that circumvents sign-up overlays on Quora by automatically manipulating URL parameters and providing custom light/dark theme controls.

GSARS.desc:
gl0bSECURE Automated Redundancy System

Automated Linux data redundancy and backup tool built for mixed drive types in storage pools. Its intended use is to have data replication without the use of RAID.

Lost Media Wiki Retheme.desc: Adaptive JavaScript UserScript that dynamically parses Lost Media Wiki page categories to conditionally inject custom layouts and CSS themes across the website.

Wake on LAN Website.desc: PHP and JavaScript network management tool that broadcasts Wake-on-LAN magic packets across local subnets. Features dynamic target host management.

YouTube Download-and-Delete.desc: Lightweight PHP web interface for YT-DLP engineered for low-capacity systems. Enables ephemeral media streaming and automated storage cleanup to allow for local network playback without persistent server disk overhead.

Filespeed.desc: PHP file-sharing web application featuring an automated abuse-filtering pipeline. Combines payload blacklisting, file extension controls, randomized URL obfuscation, execution-restricted directory policies, and detailed audit logging.

Cisco4FPBX.desc: Python automation tool engineered to streamline TFTP provisioning and XML configuration management for enterprise Cisco IP phones integrated with FreePBX virtual instances.

LiteNVR.desc: Minimal self-healing NVR system engineered to capture raw RTSP camera streams via FFmpeg and write them directly to a remote network-attached storage (NAS) share.

Slack Door Access Notify.desc: Lightweight PHP utility that captures visitor information, routing arrival events directly to Slack webhooks for real-time occupant notifications.

JS DVD Menu Simulator.desc: Client-side web framework engineered to simulate interactive DVD video menus. Utilizes vanilla JavaScript state mapping to manage branching navigation paths, media player switching, and responsive UI overlays with zero backend dependencies.

Test Drive Pong for Windows.desc: C# Windows Forms application recreating the loading screen of the PlayStation 2 racing game Test Drive.

DiskSmasher.desc: Open-source PowerShell disk-scanning and storage visualization tool. Developed via clean-room design to perform non-destructive, read-only system analysis for drive consumption tracking without altering configuration settings.

BrowserNeedle.desc: Advanced PowerShell forensic utility engineered for cross-browser artifact analysis on Windows. Extracts browsing history, installed extensions, and profile metadata across Edge, Chrome, and Firefox for incident response and security auditing.

AuditDeepscan.desc: PowerShell SecOps and threat-hunting utility for Microsoft Purview audit log analysis. Ingests CSV exports, enriches IP addresses with external threat intelligence API (flagging VPNs, proxies, and hosting nodes), and features JSON dataset caching to respect rate limits.
